title: Equal sizes carry into a tree
hook: Combining heaps can trigger a chain of equal-size carries.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Heap parent/child ordering and priority comparisons.
doesNotKnow: Meld binomial heaps by linking equal-rank trees as binary carries.

misconception: Melding two heaps requires inserting all their elements one at a time.
objective: Meld binomial heaps by linking equal-rank trees as binary carries.

claims.text: Each equal-degree link acts like a binary carry, making one tree of the next degree. Repeating carries restores at most one root per degree; the surviving degrees encode the combined heap size.
